{{Top|leg}}
A '''snoopship''' was a secretive vessel employed by [[Wraith Squadron]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. They were known to be faster than any [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and could carry [[Gravitic amplitude modulator|yammosk jammers]]. They were also utilized during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], with [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] having secretly sent one to the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]] to recover [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]] after having orchestrated a painful defeat in the [[Battle of Andalia|space battle]] there as punishment for the latter's failure to rescue an advisor from a mutiny.
